note: Named full-battle sim setups. Every sheet thread runs 'current' unless it says otherwise; only the kit maintainer moves 'current', and only when the Battle sim thread says a setup is final. Paths are relative to the repo root. 'env' is passed to the binary as is; EG_VALUE and GRID_DIR are added by the kit (GRID_DIR is the team's own grid). A setup with a 'games' field plays exactly the games of the setup it names; result folders are stamped with that name.

v4-eg5.status: What the Trick Room Six picks on sheet Versions 13-17 were run with (hand-built grid, GRID_DIR=mxtr). Superseded; kept so those numbers can be reproduced. About 4.5 s per game per thread.

v13-dp2-race-eg9.status: Superseded by v14-dp2-race-eg9, which plays the same games faster. two-turn Protect check, damage race with Speed ties averaged over both sides (v12 gave our side every tie, which favoured it in mirrors), one value file for every team. Use the team's own generic grid (the kit's grid step). About 5-5.5 s per game per thread on an idle Mac. Linux source: native/champ/src_battle_v13.tar.gz. Not comparable with v4-eg5 numbers.

v14-dp2-race-eg9.status: Same games and speed as v15-dp2-race-eg9; kept for runs already going on a box that has only this build. plays exactly v13-dp2-race-eg9's games, faster (about 39% on the Mac, less on Linux), so its results may share a folder with v13's ('games' names the setup whose games it plays). Two-turn Protect check, damage race with Speed ties averaged over both sides, one value file for every team; use the team's own generic grid. Linux source: native/champ/src_battle_v14.tar.gz (needs crates.io and a C compiler for the mimalloc allocator; --no-default-features builds without it). Not comparable with v4-eg5 numbers.

v15-dp2-race-eg9.status: Same games as v16-dp2-race-eg9, slower. plays exactly v13-dp2-race-eg9's games, faster (about 39% on the Mac, less on Linux), so its results may share a folder with v13's ('games' names the setup whose games it plays). Two-turn Protect check, damage race with Speed ties averaged over both sides, one value file for every team; use the team's own generic grid. Linux source: native/champ/src_battle_v15.tar.gz (needs crates.io and a C compiler for the mimalloc allocator; --no-default-features builds without it). Not comparable with v4-eg5 numbers.

v16-dp2-race-eg9.status: Same games as v19-dp2-race-eg9-full, but only the spot engine data (no real-team opponents) and slower in big processes. plays exactly v13-dp2-race-eg9's games about 2.3x faster than v13 (results may share a folder with v13-v15's). Two-turn Protect check, damage race with Speed ties averaged over both sides, one value file for every team; use the team's own generic grid. Linux source: native/champ/src_battle_v16.tar.gz (cargo build --release). Not comparable with v4-eg5 numbers.

v19-dp2-race-eg9-full.status: Superseded by v20 (ends games with a recharge turn early). plays exactly v13-dp2-race-eg9's games, with the full engine data (every species, move and item Showdown knows, needed for real-team opponents from pssim/opp_pool.py) and without the process-wide lock that slowed big multi-threaded processes. Linux source: native/champ/src_battle_v19.tar.gz.

v20-dp2-race-eg9-full.status: FINAL (Battle sim, 2026-10-06): the build for new runs. v19 plus a fix for locked turns (the recharge turn after Hyper Beam used to leave a side with no legal action, so the game was handed to the value function); every game without such a turn is identical to v13-v19, which is why its results share folders with theirs. Full engine data (real-team opponents). Linux source: native/champ/src_battle_v20.tar.gz.

v22-dp2-race-eg9-full.status: Battle sim, 2026-10-09: v21 plus mechanics the card opponents hit (Purifying Salt, Mummy, Wish / Healing Wish slot conditions and more; see HANDOFF.md). With v20's flags it plays v20's games except where those mechanics come up (there v20 flagged the game unsupported), so it shares v20's result folders: `kit.py <team> flagged --move` takes out the results with a flagged game and a run with SHEET_SETUP=v22-dp2-race-eg9-full replays just those. Linux source: native/champ/src_battle_v22.tar.gz. The differences (TR sheet's check, 2026-10-09) are Healing Wish and Memento, which the planner never offered before v22; replays of v20 results need `flagged --moves healingwish,memento`. Healing Wish stays free in the planner (the user's call, 2026-10-09; EG_SELFKO_RULE=1 is an opt-in restriction, in no setup). Superseded by v23.

v23-dp2-race-eg9-full.status: Battle sim, 2026-10-09: v22 plus Ripen, Swarm, Electromorphosis (Charge), Gooey, Shell Side Arm, Baton Pass, Encore's override, Ally Switch, Gravity, Champions' Curse, Entrainment, Temper Flare, Vital Spirit / Insomnia, Healer, Curious Medicine, Seed Sower (see HANDOFF.md; still flagged: Unseen Fist, Cute Charm). With v20's flags it plays v20's games except where those mechanics come up, so it shares v20's result folders: `kit.py <team> flagged --write`, then a run with SHEET_SETUP=v23-dp2-race-eg9-full replays just those. Linux source: native/champ/src_battle_v23.tar.gz. The differences (TR sheet's check, 2026-10-09) are Healing Wish and Memento, which the planner never offered before v22; replays of v20 results need `flagged --moves healingwish,memento`. Healing Wish stays free in the planner (the user's call, 2026-10-09; EG_SELFKO_RULE=1 is an opt-in restriction, in no setup). The version for replays and the next current (there is no v24); current stays v20 until the sheets running on v20 have replayed.
